editorial: Buckle up for a high-voltage clash of egos where raw masculinity meets systemic power. You get a stylized feast of territorial warfare that prioritizes bravado and punchy dialogue over subtle storytelling. Prithviraj Sukumaran dominates every frame with a commanding screen presence that elevates the entire conflict. If you crave loud, unapologetic mass cinema with explosive confrontations, this is your brand of adrenaline.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of alpha-protagonists and high-stakes power struggles.
